summary: GameplayKit is a game-logic framework: entities and components, state machines, pathfinding and agents, noise, decision and rule systems, and seeded randomness. BifrOSt has no app-facing SDK API for any of the game-logic parts. Its only counterpart is randomness: a clock-or-pinned seed helper in the SDK testing kit, and each app keeps its own xorshift generator. The Games app and the Music app both use that pattern.

features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Wave 3 (theme-07, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No entity-component runtime in springboard/sdk/src/ or springboard/ui/src/. Apps hold their own state structs (for example springboard/apps/games-desktop/src/games.rs).

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. State machines are hand-written per subsystem. No reusable SDK state machine with enter, exit and transition rules.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/random.rs (Source, Algorithm, Mt19937); springboard/core/src/random.rs (RandomDistribution, GaussianDistribution, ShuffledDistribution, shuffle); springboard/sdk/src/testing.rs:52 (seed(), PINNED_SEED); springboard/apps/games-desktop/src/games.rs:150 (xorshift rand over bifrost_core::random); springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music/upnext.rs:19 (shuffle_slice, Fisher-Yates)
features.note: An app picks xorshift, SplitMix or Mersenne Twister with one SDK call and draws uniform ranges, Gaussian values, shuffled bags and shuffles from it; the rules are tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-complete-32.rs. Gap: the ARC4 generator of the reference set is not offered, because it is a broken cipher that no game needs; nothing here needs hardware, and the lab machine only confirms that seeded deals match on Midget.
Tied to Apple's SpriteKit and SceneKit scene graphs and the Xcode editor. BifrOSt has no SpriteKit or SceneKit equivalent.

features.apple: GKGameModelMaxScore, GKGameModelMinScore, GKBox, GKQuad, GKTriangle, GKMeshGraphTriangulationMode, GKRTreeSplitStrategy
features.note: Audit 2026-10-13: the row predated this code. Pure model with host unit tests (strategist.rs, rule_system.rs, state_machine.rs); not wired into the shell or apps, not tested on Midget. Value types depend on the spatial, graph and strategist rows, which are all missing.

gaps: No SDK pathfinding or navigation graph (GKGraph family): no grid, mesh or obstacle graph and no route search.
No SDK random source or distribution API: apps copy an xorshift generator, and only seed() is exposed, under the test kit.
No procedural noise (Perlin, Voronoi, billow, ridged) for apps.
No reusable state machine, entity-component system, or rule and decision system for game logic.
No spatial partitioning (quadtree, octree, R-tree) for apps.
No turn-based AI (minimax or Monte Carlo strategist) or agent steering (goals, behaviors, obstacles).
SpriteKit and SceneKit integration has no BifrOSt counterpart, so it is n/a.
